description:
You weren’t born just to save money, you were born to live. 💸✨
A night with friends or a trip somewhere new? That’s not wasted money.
That’s an investment in your joy, your memories, your life.

What experience are you ready to stop postponing and finally say yes to?

👉 If you want a direct link to listen to The Mindset Mentor Podcast comment "LISTEN NOW" below and I'll message it to you now!
transcript: being so afraid to spend your money. You drop $100 in a night with friends, so what? You created great memories. You spent $1,000 on travel, so what? That's an experience that you'll remember the rest of your life. We've got it all backwards. We obsess over saving every single dollar while our lives just kind of slip by. Money comes and goes, but time, time only goes. You can always make more money, but you can't get more time. So let yourself live a little bit. Go do things. Use your money to buy memories. The real flex isn't hoarding money or buying a new car. The real flex is living a life fully while you're here.
